name: Original Natural Caverns tutorial alchemy kit: acquisition

files.content:
replace=config
replace=data
resources="{resources}"
data="{oblivion_data}"
content=Oblivion.esm
start=ImperialDungeon01
skip-menu=1
new-game=0
no-grab=1
user-data="{output}/userdata"
data-local="{output}/test-data"
content=tutorial-passage-observer.omwscripts

[Video]
resolution x = 1280
resolution y = 720
fullscreen = false
framerate limit = 60
[General]
screenshot format = png

[Input]
enable controller = true

[GUI]
controller menus = false

[Input]
camera sensitivity = 0.5

local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local elapsed=-1
local approachStep=1
local approachPoints={{util.vector3(-323,838,0),util.vector3(-310,865,0)}}
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 elapsed=elapsed+dt;if elapsed<.2 then return end;elapsed=0
 assert(not Actor.isDead(self),'Player died at original tutorial alchemy kit')
 print('AlchemyKit Player '..tostring(self.position)..' health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current)
 local inventory=Actor.inventory(self)
 local ids={{0xc7968,0x6251f,0x8446d}};local refs={{0xc796f,0xc796e,0xc796d}}
 if approachStep<=#approachPoints then
 local p=approachPoints[approachStep];local delta=p-self.position
 if math.sqrt(delta.x*delta.x+delta.y*delta.y)<15 then print('AlchemyKit waypoint '..approachStep..' reached');approachStep=approachStep+1;return end
 local view=camera.viewportToWorldVector(util.vector2(.5,.5));local yaw=math.atan2(view.y*delta.x-view.x*delta.y,view.x*delta.x+view.y*delta.y)
 print(string.format('AlchemyKit waypoint %d aim x=%d y=%d',approachStep,math.max(-100,math.min(100,math.floor(yaw*256+.5))),0))
 if math.abs(yaw)<.025 then print('AlchemyKit waypoint '..approachStep..' facing') end
 return
 end
 local step=nil
 for i,id in ipairs(ids) do
  local count=inventory:countOf(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',id))
  print('AlchemyKit stock '..i..'='..count)
  if count==0 and not step then step=i end
 end
 print('AlchemyKit Player '..tostring(self.position)..' health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current)
 if not step then print('AlchemyKit complete');return end
 local obj=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',refs[step]));assert(obj and obj:isValid(),'Original kit reference missing')
 local box=obj:getBoundingBox();print('AlchemyKit target '..step..' id='..obj.id..' base='..obj.recordId..' root='..tostring(obj.position)..' center='..tostring(box.center));local aim=nil
 for _,x in ipairs({{0,-.6,.6}}) do for _,y in ipairs({{0,-.6,.6}}) do for _,z in ipairs({{0,-.6,.6}}) do
 local candidate=box.center+util.vector3(x*math.max(16,box.halfSize.x),y*math.max(16,box.halfSize.y),z*math.max(16,box.halfSize.z))
 local ray=nearby.castRenderingRay(camera.getPosition(),candidate,{{ignore=self}})
 if ray.hitObject==obj then aim=ray.hitPos;break end
 end;if aim then break end end;if aim then break end end
 local point=camera.getViewTransform():apply(aim or box.center)
 local ax=math.atan2(point.x,-point.z);local ay=-math.atan2(point.y,math.sqrt(point.x*point.x+point.z*point.z))
 local function units(a) return math.max(-100,math.min(100,math.floor(a*256+.5))) end
 print(string.format('AlchemyKit aim %d x=%d y=%d',step,units(ax),units(ay)))
 local origin=camera.getPosition();local view=camera.viewportToWorldVector(util.vector2(.5,.5))
 local hit=nearby.castRenderingRay(origin,origin+view*2000,{{ignore=self}})
 if hit.hitObject==obj then print('AlchemyKit visible '..step..' distance='..(hit.hitPos-origin):length());if (hit.hitPos-origin):length()<140 then print('AlchemyKit in range '..step) end end
end}}}}
